_meta.description: Bank of England staff judgements on the UK labour market, entered by hand from each Monetary Policy Report. The Bank publishes its underlying employment growth measure as a chart only; 'underlying_value' is the staff's verbal judgement read as a number (e.g. 'around zero' = 0.0) and is approximate. Unemployment projections are quoted exactly.
_meta.method: Bank staff's indicator-based measure of underlying employment growth is constructed using a dynamic factor model following the approach of Doz et al (2011). The model extracts a common component from monthly survey indicators, capturing comovements across series. The common component is scaled to align with LFS employment growth between 2000-19.
_meta.method_source: Monetary Policy Report, chart notes (May 2025 to July 2026)
